annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page describing EU machinery safety legislation: Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, applicable from 20 January 2027. It covers AI-powered safety functions, cybersecurity, conformity assessment, market surveillance, notified bodies, application guides and warnings about voluntary certificates.
key_provisions_or_claims: Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 adopted 14 June 2023 and applies from 20 January 2027.
Regulation integrates provisions for AI-powered machinery safety functions and cybersecurity of safety control software.
Stricter conformity assessment for higher-risk machinery, with notified bodies.
Article 6(9) requires Member States to report accident and health damage data.
Voluntary certificates are not recognised proof of compliance; CE marking only after conformity assessment.
